description: View execution history for IRIS scheduled tasks. Optionally filter by task ID. Each entry includes task name, start time, completion time, status, result, namespace, and username. Results are capped by maxRows (default 100, max 1000).

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

taskId.description: Task ID to filter history (omit for all tasks)

name: iris_task_history
title: Task History
